entries.e2565b61506013e7: The domestic reuse market continues to expand, and policy support is also strengthening, with the Ministry of the Environment formulating a roadmap to promote reuse. In an industry where store-based operations were the mainstream, the company is distinctive in having continued since its founding with a buyback and sales model focused on the internet, and it captures secondary-distribution demand through two businesses alongside the mobile communications business.
entries.e32dbc73abd08bf5: The company lists as its challenges further growth of the online-type reuse business, its core business, and stabilizing the earnings base of the mobile communications business. In the reuse business, the company is working to improve productivity and service quality through the use of AI and to expand its purchasing channels, and for 'Oikura' it states that it will promote cooperation with local governments and accelerate the handling of used GIGA School terminals and similar devices. In the mobile communications business, the company is shifting its business structure away from reliance on shot-type income generated when new lines are acquired toward stock-type income continuously obtained from lines it holds, and it plans to revise the monthly basic fee from October 2026.
entries.e4a5e3867fc5d875: The sales mix is roughly half and half between the online-type reuse business and the mobile communications business, but the company positions the reuse business as the main axis of its growth. The mobile communications business relies heavily on sales to certain major customers, and whether its earnings structure shifts will determine the stability of the group as a whole.
entries.e884715413798c3f: The sales mix is roughly half and half between the online-type reuse business and the mobile communications business, but the company positions the reuse business as the main axis of its growth.
entries.fd716c84ab937dbf: The company has its own buyback model that combines advance online appraisal with nationwide service, and it standardizes appraisal and sales know-how in a manual titled 'STANDARD BOOK', which is shared across the company. Its in-house centralized inventory management system allows simultaneous listings on multiple marketplaces, which contributes to a high product turnover rate. As of June 30, 2026, 'Oikura' is linked with 336 local governments, and its ties with municipalities are also one of its strengths.
